scope: certified axis-aligned box face interiors, shared rigid motion snapshots, whole-object bounds; immutable BVH retained
direct_geometry: exact 8 vertices and canonical 12 triangles, closed outward solid; face projection separated from all face edges by >= particle radius + 1e-10m
fallback: edges, corners, near-surface singularities, transformed/noncanonical boxes, general meshes keep original triangle contacts and feature IDs
numeric: abs(a-b)<=1e-12 + 1e-9*max(abs(a),abs(b)); discrete contact/step/arrival counts and statuses exact
motion: start and end pose built each step, existing angular/travel guards and segment crossing guard retained
benchmark: 3 alternating unprofiled repeats vs preserved optimization04, one profiled each; compare wall phase time separately
